The '''Felucia theater''', also known as the '''Felucian theater''', was one of the six theaters of operations of the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], which took place during the final stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Astrography==
The Felucia theater was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> This field of operations was named after the key [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
The Felucia theater was home to many of the Confederacy's key [[Factory world/Legends|factory worlds]], known together as the [[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Foundry of the Confederacy]]. As the Confederacy sought to protect its industrial worlds, the Felucia theater saw some of the fiercest fighting of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The campaign resulted in costly [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] victories at [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]], [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], Felucia and [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
